excess_admission_penalty.text: Fine of five times the total course fee collected per excess student, plus possible suspension of supernumerary seats, intake reduction or withdrawal of approval. A show-cause notice comes first.
excess_admission_penalty.source: AICTE Approval Process Handbook, excess-admission clause; Supreme Court, FORE School of Management v AICTE (21 Jun 2019)

FN_OCI_PIO.label: Foreign nationals / OCI / PIO (incl. children of Indian workers in Gulf countries)
FN_OCI_PIO.source: AICTE APH 2026-27 addendum: 15% for UG engineering, 25% for PG engineering, management, design and other programmes. CIWG share reverted to the earlier arrangement by AICTE circular of 28 Sep 2026.
FN_OCI_PIO.note: Diploma value is an assumption (same as UG); confirm with the handbook in force.

TFW.label: Tuition Fee Waiver
TFW.source: Up to 5% of approved intake, supernumerary (AICTE APH as cited in MRSPTU TFW notice 2024-25 and Central University of Punjab supernumerary-seat notice 2025-26 under APH 2024-27).

LATERAL.label: Lateral entry into the second year
LATERAL.source: Up to 10% of approved intake plus vacant first-year seats per AICTE Handbook 2019-20 (Tamil Nadu G.O. 68, 2019); not yet confirmed in APH 2024-27, so excess is flagged for review, not rejected.

EWS.label: Economically Weaker Section (where sanctioned as supernumerary)
EWS.source: Applies only where EWS seats are sanctioned as supernumerary; value is a demo assumption, so excess is flagged for review, not rejected.
